data.content_ref: inline:Isolated 05b29af78bfb DEPENDS ON SRC_005's category-error claim by adopting the within-vs-across-distribution framing, but ADVANCES the mechanism by proposing that the appropriate signature is not within-evaluation error structure but the rate of checklist-rule invocations during retrospective protocol analysis: genuine reasoners will invoke rules they later reject, while mere compliers will only invoke rules they follow. This is a process-trace reduction of the distinction. This relation is refuted if 05b29af78bfb proposes no retrospective-protocol observable and rests entirely on prospective distributional shift, or if SRC_005's countercondition (process traces already detect the distinction) makes the advance trivial rather than substantive.
